scope: Follow-up local fixes for missing/tiny catalog thumbnails and persistent selection tint while changing appearance
root_causes: A newly staged model could be captured before a full offscreen render, and transparent empty images were accepted into the cache
Reusing an interpolated thumbnail camera across model sizes produced inconsistent framing; a repeated lamp after a floor used only 24x31 pixels versus its intended 60x75 in the standalone probe
Selecting or modifying a material part repeatedly applied a persistent green mesh overlay
fixes: Disable physical interpolation for the offscreen camera and model stage; force and reset camera transforms after reframing
Render at least two complete frames, reject empty image content, retry failed captures and repair invalid cached images
Deduplicate an in-flight thumbnail key and keep custom variants separate from catalog defaults
Part identification is a brief neutral hint of 0.35 seconds; color/texture adjustments clear it immediately, and saving does not restart it
coverage: All 27 catalog images contain visible image pixels
Three independent cold viewport startups capture a floor followed by a legibly sized lamp
Alternating large floor and small lamp retains consistent framing
Injected transparent cached image is regenerated and rebound
Customized lamp image contains changed pixels and does not overwrite the catalog default
Appearance hint clears automatically and is absent during actual color preview
Prior whole-wall camera, resets, save/undo, movement and mouse building regressions
environment: macOS / Apple M1 Pro / Godot4.6.3 / Metal Forward+; isolated progress
limits: Rendering and framing assertions cover the current catalog, not arbitrary future models
deployment: No export, deployment, version bump, commit or push; no real player progress files manually modified
